title: Bisect the first bad build
hints: Pattern: binary search over a monotone predicate. Good, good, good, bad, bad: halving the range each time finds the boundary in log2(n) steps.
Keep lo = 1 and hi = n_builds with the invariant "the first bad build, if there is one, is in [lo, hi]"; loop while lo < hi.
If is_bad(mid): the answer could be mid itself, so hi = mid. Otherwise mid is good, so lo = mid + 1. Never set hi = mid - 1.
When the loop ends lo == hi, but nothing has confirmed that build is bad; one last is_bad(lo) decides between lo and None.
